Explicit T0/T1/T2/T3/T4/T5 draft edits, including foundation, retrieval, agent and training selections. Catalog choices below are synthetic fixtures. These controls do not evaluate compatibility, cost, deployment requirements or readiness. Save or explicitly reopen pending form edits before changing components.

Replace only this selection’s settings with the exact JSON object below. Required settings must remain present. Raw credentials must never be entered; only opaque secret references are allowed where the frozen schema permits them. Invalid input remains visible and does not save.

Optional whole-number overrides: concurrency and latency_budget_ms must be at least 1; requests_per_day, avg_input_tokens and avg_output_tokens may be 0 or greater. Omitted keys stay unanswered. These values belong to this workload selection; the separate Workload assumptions fields are not copied or changed.

The exact catalog item defines API, managed, self-hosted or hybrid mode. This selection accepts only an empty settings object: {}. Changing the item does not adapt other components or confirm that the mode is supported.

Choose the role and enabled state explicitly. An incomplete local draft may keep this selection disabled or use another role. Snapshot preparation requires one enabled primary selection of this kind; saving here does not establish overall readiness.

All settings are optional: connector_secret_ref uses an opaque secret:// reference; refresh_minutes is an integer of at least 1; enabled is true or false. The enabled setting is separate from this component’s enabled checkbox and T3 intent. Saving does not read or ingest source data.

All settings are optional: chunk_size_tokens and refresh_minutes are integers of at least 1; chunk_overlap_tokens is an integer of at least 0; acl_enforced is true or false. An ACL declaration does not verify access control or permission to use data.

All settings are optional: output_dimensions is an integer of at least 1; region is text; credential_ref uses an opaque secret:// reference. Saving does not resolve the reference, run embeddings or verify the declared dimensions against another component.

Required settings: index_dimension is an integer of at least 1; similarity_metric is cosine, dot or euclidean. Optional settings: region is text; index_name is nonempty text; credential_ref uses an opaque secret:// reference. Enter these values explicitly. Saving does not create an index or verify catalog, dimension or metric compatibility.

All settings are optional: top_k and max_chunks are integers of at least 1; rerank_enabled is true or false. Saving does not execute retrieval, add other components or verify that reranking is supported.

T3 intent is separate from each component’s enabled state. Change T3 intent in the optional-tier controls. Unknown intent keeps snapshot preparation unavailable. Enabled T3 needs at least one enabled T3 component; disabled T3 needs every T3 component disabled. These settings do not establish access rights or interoperability.

All settings are optional: agent_count, max_iterations and timeout_ms are integers of at least 1. Saving does not start an agent, invoke a tool or verify that this framework supports the proposed workload.

All settings are optional: enabled is true or false; allowed_scopes is a JSON array of unique strings; timeout_ms is an integer of at least 1; credential_ref uses an opaque secret:// reference. Entered scopes describe intended access. They grant no permission and do not verify that required scopes are satisfied.

All settings are optional: endpoint is a URI; credential_ref uses an opaque secret:// reference; read_only is true or false. Transport and authentication capabilities belong to the exact catalog item. Do not put credentials in endpoint text. Saving does not connect a server, verify transport compatibility or restrict its actual tools.

All settings are optional: ttl_hours and max_entries are integers of at least 1; encryption_key_ref uses an opaque secret:// reference. These declarations do not create memory, delete stored data, resolve a key or verify encryption and retention behavior.

All settings are optional: enabled is true or false; endpoint is a URI; credential_ref uses an opaque secret:// reference; rate_limit_per_minute is an integer of at least 0. Do not put credentials in endpoint text. Saving does not connect an account, send a request or verify that the entered rate is supported.

T4 intent is separate from each component’s enabled state and any enabled setting. Change T4 intent in the optional-tier controls. Unknown intent keeps snapshot preparation unavailable. Enabled T4 needs at least one enabled T4 component; disabled T4 needs every T4 component disabled. Saving these inputs grants no external permission and proves no workload compatibility.

All settings are optional: method is sft, lora, qlora, dpo, full_finetune or distillation; epochs and learning_rate are numbers greater than 0; batch_size is an integer of at least 1. An entered method does not prove support for this model, framework or training configuration.

All settings are optional: gpu_hours_budget is a number of at least 0; spot_allowed is true or false; checkpoint_interval_minutes is an integer of at least 1. The exact catalog item supplies its compute and storage references. A GPU-hour budget is an entered limit, not a price, capacity measurement or allocation.

All settings are optional: train_split, eval_split and test_split are numbers from 0 to 1; redaction_enabled is true or false. Each fraction is retained independently without automatic normalization. Source identities and recorded governance declarations belong to the exact catalog item. A redaction choice does not process data or approve its use.

All settings are optional: use_adapter is true or false; artifact_uri is a URI; revision is text and may be empty. Keep credentials out of the URI. The exact catalog item retains artifact format and base-model, framework and dataset lineage. A URI or adapter choice does not establish access, export support or serving compatibility.

T5 intent is separate from each component’s enabled state. Change T5 intent in the optional-tier controls. Unknown intent keeps snapshot preparation unavailable. Enabled T5 needs at least one enabled T5 component; disabled T5 needs every T5 component disabled. Saving grants no dataset or model-weight rights and starts no training or download. Missing prices, measurements and eligibility evidence remain unknown and unpriced.
